title: Huyang
description: Professor Huyang was an ancient Droid who spent centuries in service to the Jedi Order. In his memory banks were the plans to every Lightsaber he helped younglings construct under his supervision. During the Clone Wars, he spent his time aboard a ship named the Crucible, escorting younglings to Ilum where they would retrieve their kyber crystals and construct their first Lightsabers. Somehow, he made it through the rise and fall of the Empire and joined Ahsoka Tano on her journeys through the New Republic.
